core_idea: LCCB Assistant Manager Ryōshū is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Poise is a self-buff: on hit it rolls a Potency-based crit for 1.2x damage.
playstyle_guide:
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **O.O.F.** — **S2 — T.N.** adds **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin and **+1 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **The Lucky Cig** adds **+3 Poise** at **On Use**.
- **O.O.F.** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- Manage **Ammo** — S3 spends ammo on its coin flips. Preserve **Ammo** for S3; when reserves are low, skip or pass on weaker S1, S2 so your strongest skill keeps fully empowered coins.

**S1 — Shove** (BP 5, CP +5, 1 coin): rolls — low 5, high 10 (Extremely Low).
- Wait for 7+ Poise before this damage condition activates.

**S2 — T.N.** (BP 4, CP +5, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Needs 7+ Poise to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.

**S3 — O.O.F.** (BP 4, CP +3, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 13 (Low).
- Gain 4 Poise; Gain +1 Coin Power for every 7 Poise on self (max 2)

Combat passive — **A S.B.**: Always Active : Begin encounters with 7 Ammo.
  - If this unit has 7+ Poise at Turn End, heal 8 SP.
  - If this unit already has max SP upon meeting this condition, gain 1 Poise next turn.

Combat passive — **The Lucky Cig**: If 1 ally with the least Ammo uses a Skill that spends Ammo, gain 3 Poise. (once per turn.
  - does not apply to allies without Ammo).
  - If 1 ally with the least Ammo uses up their last Ammo with a Coin, deal 50% of the damage dealt by that Coin attack against each target a….
